system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Warding Network

Your determination and chakra reserves are powerful enough to keep you standing, despite your body suffering grievous injury. When you would fall to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction or 2 Spiral Cells to instead be reduced to 1. Each time you would use this feature, you gain 1 rank of Weakened.
